name: Gratitude
description: Gratitude word search puzzles gather quiet appreciation English for adults and seniors — thanks, blessing, comfort, share, table and everyday kindness words — without greeting-card slogans or medical claims. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays warm and ordinary: family, friend, meal, letter, morning and graceful vocabulary many people already use at a quiet table. This hub pairs well with Kindness, Friendship, Meditation and Thanksgiving when you want a longer reflective session without repeating a holiday-only list. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as soft as evening light.
